title: Joshua Cheong
tagline: Betting Game in Matic network with Chainlink based from Dapp University's game.  This is to test that Chainlink Oracles can operate independently from Ethereum Mainnet, with Matic.
description:
This is an implementation of the Betting Game in Matic network with Chainlink based from Dapp University's example
(see video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YzCbaR15Xi4)

This tests out that Chainlink Oracles can operate independently from Ethereum Mainnet, in this case with Matic Mumbai Testnet.
how_its_made:
The project was built on Matic, Solidity, Chainlink contracts (VRF, Price Feeds).



This is an implementation of the Betting Game in Matic network with Chainlink based from Dapp University's example

(see video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YzCbaR15Xi4)



This tests out that Chainlink Oracles can operate independently from Ethereum Mainnet, in this case with Matic Mumbai Testnet.
